description: This file implements user settings management within a plugin framework, handling storage, retrieval, and notification of user preferences such as audio descriptions, language settings, privacy modes, and restrictions. It interfaces with a remote store and handles events and callbacks for changes in user settings.

classes.name: UserSettingsImplementation
classes.description: Class managing user settings, remote store interactions, event notifications, and system integration for user preferences.

methods.name: SetAudioDescription
methods.description: Sets the audio description enabled state.

methods.name: GetAudioDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the current audio description enabled state.

methods.name: SetPreferredAudioLanguages
methods.description: Sets the user's preferred audio languages.

methods.name: GetPreferredAudioLanguages
methods.description: Gets the user's preferred audio languages.

methods.name: GetCaptions
methods.description: Gets the current captions enabled state.

methods.name: SetPreferredClosedCaptionService
methods.description: Sets the preferred closed caption service.

methods.name: GetPreferredClosedCaptionService
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred closed caption service.

methods.name: SetLiveWatershed
methods.description: Enables or disables live watershed setting.

methods.name: SetBlockNotRatedContent
methods.description: Enables or disables blocking of not rated content.

methods.name: GetBlockNotRatedContent
methods.description: Retrieves block not rated content setting.

methods.name: SetPinOnPurchase
methods.description: Enables or disables PIN requirement on purchase.
